# SINMOS TECHNOLOGY — Professional Trail Camera Manufacturer

> SHENZHEN SINMOS TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD is a professional trail camera (hunting camera) manufacturer founded in 2015, headquartered in Shenzhen, China. We design and manufacture high-performance trail cameras for global distributors, brand owners, importers, and outdoor retailers. All products are CE, FCC, and RoHS certified. We offer OEM & ODM services including logo printing, custom packaging, firmware customization, and private label manufacturing from 100 pcs.

## Company Facts
- Company Name: SHENZHEN SINMOS TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD

- OEM/ODM: Yes — logo printing, custom packaging, firmware customization, private label

## Key Products (Trail Cameras)
- PR1600: 60MP photo, 4K video, WiFi, IP66 waterproof — mid-range WiFi trail camera
- PR8000: 60MP photo, 8K video, WiFi, night vision 49-66ft — high-resolution WiFi trail camera
- PR801LTE: 60MP CMOS sensor, 8K video, 4G LTE, IP66 — cellular trail camera with remote monitoring
- PR903G: 60MP, solar-powered, 4G LTE, IP66, night vision — solar cellular trail camera
- PR802LTE: 60MP, 4G LTE transmission, IP66, night vision 49-66ft — cellular trail camera
- H2G: 60MP, 4G LTE, solar panel, 7800mAh built-in battery — solar 4G trail camera
- DL001: 1080P HD video, IP54 waterproof, IR night vision, motion detection — entry-level trail camera
- PR903DW: 60MP, 4K video, WiFi, solar, 940nm no-glow night vision, 5200mAh battery — solar WiFi trail camera
- PR700: 58MP photo, 2.7K video, IP66 waterproof, 120° detection angle — mid-range trail camera
- PR1200: 36MP photo, 1080P video, 0.2s trigger speed, 15-20M IR night vision — fast-trigger trail camera
- H1W: 60MP, 8K video, WiFi, solar, 7800mAh battery — high-end solar WiFi trail camera

## FAQ
- What is your MOQ? Stock models: 1 pc. OEM/ODM orders: from 100 pcs.
- Do you support OEM/ODM? Yes. Logo printing, custom packaging, firmware customization, private label manufacturing.
- What certifications? CE, FCC, RoHS — compliant for European and North American markets.
- Delivery time? Stock: 3-7 days. OEM: 15-25 days depending on customization.
- Can I test samples? Yes, sample orders welcome (MOQ 1 pc), sample cost deducted from first bulk order.
- Quality assurance? 100% inspection — sensor calibration, trigger speed test, waterproof seal check, 24-hour aging test.
